capabilities: Upload attachments from monitored folders or the current file to cloud storage
Update note links to point to cloud-stored files
Filter uploads by file extension whitelist/blacklist and maximum file size
Move or delete local files after successful upload
Manage and delete cloud files through a web interface
disambiguation: Not a full-vault sync tool; it uploads attachments and embedded media files, not the notes themselves.
extras: Freemium: advanced features (file filtering, max file size, cloud renaming) are subscription-only; free accounts have storage and egress limits. Custom S3-compatible storage is listed as 'coming soon'.
problem: Obsidian keeps attachments as local files, which fills up vault storage and makes sharing or accessing files across devices difficult.

relations.evidence: We would like to express our sincere gratitude to the Remotely Save project for their inspiration

requires.name: Premium subscription for file filtering, size limits, and renaming

summary: Attachment uploader that moves embedded files to cloud storage (plugin-hosted or S3), rewrites note links to cloud URLs, and frees local vault space.
